item.title: Guterres urges faster action and financing to stop biodiversity loss
item.description: The United Nations Secretary-General appealed on Friday for governments, businesses and communities to accelerate efforts to protect biodiversity for future generations and all life on Earth.

item.title: WHO scales up Ebola readiness in 22 countries across three continents
item.description: The World Health Organization (WHO) is strengthening Ebola preparedness amid conflict and displacement affecting millions of lives in a region that spans parts of Africa, Asia and Europe.

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Sudan’s war spreads as drones and hunger take a deadly toll
item.description: As drone strikes kill civilians from El Obeid to Blue Nile and famine risk spreads across Darfur and Kordofan, the Security Council meets on Sudan – the world’s largest hunger and displacement crisis. Ambassadors are expected to press yet again for a ceasefire, safe aid access and an end to the weapons flows fuelling the brutal conflict.

item.title: Gaza: 340 children killed despite ceasefire agreement - UNICEF
item.description: A little over one year since a ceasefire agreement was announced between Hamas fighters and Israel, more than 340 children have been reported killed and hundreds more injured, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.

item.title: As disasters mount, next UN climate summit faces a test of trust
item.description: Less than a month before the UN climate conference COP31 opens in Antalya, Türkiye, representatives of three successive summit presidencies gathered to address a pressing question: How can the world restore trust in climate action when the consequences of a warming planet are already being felt?

item.title: Ukraine: Civilian casualty rates among ‘deadliest’ in years, as energy attacks intensify
item.description: Civilian casualties in Ukraine remain at record levels, with intensified Russian attacks in September continuing a pattern of harm in 2026 far exceeding previous years, UN human rights monitors in Ukraine said on Friday.
